title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Friday, 6 November 2026
description: Australia's education ministers agree to limit generative AI in classrooms, an independent inquiry slams the AUKUS submarine deal and calls for it to be scrapped, Queensland faces criticism over blocking a UN visit to a youth detention centre, and the Gold Coast kicks off the Pan Pacific Masters Games. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
